about: T-18 P3, the follower daemon's edge cases (2026-10-21). Tall grass over its feet; its reflection above still water; the order it is drawn in, above and below a person; someone in its tile (it gives way by not being drawn); hidefollower in OAK's lab, where the rival walks into the tile behind you; ledges east and west; rock stairs; spin tiles, ice and a STRENGTH boulder (hidden for forced moves, out again after; currents take the same flag, PLAYER_AVATAR_FLAG_FORCED, and WATERFALL is surfing); FLASH; DOLDRUM CAVE unread (grey as the player is); BREATHVERSE's sand and its one-tile bridge; THE NEXUS's fir doors; the crowded maps (KINDLE ROAD, ROCK TUNNEL B1F); AWAY, egg and HALTED leads; an evolution or a trade changing the lead; a shiny lead; no free OBJ palette slot; the CASINO's slot machine; and a save, then Continue (it is back a tile behind). Run with every daemon's friendship at 255 so the colour shows. Debug scratch save: every flag, var and party change a stop makes is put back at its end.

stops.stop: tall grass over its feet: ROUTE 1
steps: shot in the grass: the blades in front of its feet
shot walking north in the grass
shot out of the grass: no blades left behind

stops.stop: a reflection: VIRIDIAN's pond
steps: shot above the water: it is reflected, as the player is
shot away from the water: no reflection

stops.stop: the order it is drawn in: above and below a person (VIRIDIAN's tutor)
steps: shot above the person: the person is drawn in front of it
shot below the person: it is drawn in front of the person

stops.stop: someone in its tile (VIRIDIAN's tutor, put there): it gives way, then is there again
steps: shot someone in its tile: not drawn
shot they have gone: drawn again, where it stood

stops.stop: hidefollower: OAK's lab, the rival walks into the tile behind you
steps: shot the scene over: it is back

stops.stop: ledges east and west: FUCHSIA
steps: shot jumped east: it waits on the ground before the ledge
shot and jumps it on the next step
shot jumped west, and it after

stops.stop: rock stairs: INDIGO PLATEAU's steps
steps: shot up the stairs: it is on them, a tile behind

stops.stop: spin tiles: CORPUS's hideout (B2F)
steps: shot spun: hidden while the floor moves the player
shot stopped: on the player's tile, hidden

stops.stop: ice: ICEFALL CAVE B1F
steps: shot on the ice: hidden while it carries the player
shot off the ice: it walked out of the player again

stops.stop: a STRENGTH boulder: VICTORY ROAD 1F
steps: shot the boulder pushed: the player did not move, nor did it

stops.stop: FLASH: ROCK TUNNEL dark, then lit
the crowded maps: ROCK TUNNEL B1F (26 people) and KINDLE ROAD (30)
steps: shot ROCK TUNNEL B1F, lit: it follows

stops.stop: DOLDRUM CAVE unread: grey, as the player is
steps: shot DOLDRUM CAVE unread: the four tones, it too

stops.stop: BREATHVERSE: the sand ring and its one-tile bridge
steps: shot down the bridge, a tile behind

stops.stop: THE NEXUS: out by a grove's door and back by its fir
steps: shot through the door: on the player's tile
shot back in THE NEXUS by the fir, behind

stops.stop: who follows: AWAY, an egg, every daemon HALTED
steps: shot the lead AWAY: the second daemon follows
shot the lead an egg: the second daemon follows
shot every daemon HALTED: nobody follows

stops.stop: an evolution or a trade: the lead becomes another daemon where it stands
steps: shot after: the new picture, where it stood

stops.stop: a shiny lead: its shiny colours (UNOWN, whose shiny palette differs)
steps: shot the lead itself, shiny: the same colours (its shiny palette is its normal one)

stops.stop: no free OBJ palette slot: it is not drawn, never in another's colours, and comes back when one frees
steps: shot slots 12-15 all held: no follower
shot a slot free again: it is back

stops.stop: the CASINO: a pull at a slot machine, and back where it stood
steps: shot the GAME CORNER: it follows between the machines
shot back from the machine: where it stood

stops.stop: save, then Continue: it is back a tile behind the player
steps: shot continued: a tile behind, not inside the player
